items.title: Text AI watermarks will always be trivial to remove
items.raw_excerpt: The European Union AI Act will begin to be enforceable in August 2026, one month from now 1 . One of the biggest new requirements is Article 50 , which requires all AI outputs to be “detectable as artificially generated”.
